note: 12 sealed-bid rounds among 20 bidders (at most 16 admitted per auction, reputation floor 40%). 9 rounds delivered verified work for 28.151 NEAR; in 3 the winner did not deliver and 4.969 NEAR of escrow went back to the treasury. Failures took market-w15 (undercutter) from round 4 below the floor, so it could no longer bid. No-show bids delayed 12 closes to the reveal deadline but never blocked one. market-w01 won 9 of 9 delivered rounds: reputation is 30% of the score and every verified delivery adds 2.5%, so the incumbent's lead grows.
